system.description:
Attack is the best form of defense.

Attack (Fist): Make a Power Roll against the target. On a success the target takes d8 + 4 damage.

Reach (Fist): Mark a Stress before you make an attack roll to increase the range to Far instead of Close.
system.gmNotes: The printed stat line says d8 + 6 damage; the Attack feature says d8 + 4. Both are kept as printed.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v3.0 Fist
